description:
Local tools that let your AI use Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Teams, WhatsApp, Telegram, OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint, Outlook and Office files on Windows. Runs on your computer.

LMCP is a local MCP server that lets your AI assistant work with the apps and files on your own computer: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Google Drive, WhatsApp, Telegram, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files, local files, web and UI automation, and more.
Install the LMCP app first; your AI client then starts the server with npx -y local-mcp@latest. Web assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude.ai connect through an optional relay that is off by default.
Your AI provider still receives the content you ask it to process.
